note: Code lists used by the EN16931 data set. All values are UNVERIFIED: the sources found are secondary and the lists are versioned by their maintainers (the VATEX list is published about every six months). The verification records the list versions. The core's configuration validation of 07, 8.3 and 12, 9.2 is the rule in force, this file documents the standard it follows
